content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result:** TRANSITION — *missing* (no usable exit clause anywhere in the Agreement).

- **Investigated:** §3.5 Effect of Termination (payment obligations only), §3.4 Termination for Convenience (IBM performs until final termination date, but no post-termination help), §14.18 Data Protection, §11.6 Content, §14.2 Survival, plus full-text searches for transition/export/deletion/migration — all silent on data return and exit assistance.
- **Terminology:** the contract has no "Customer Data" defined term; our data is "Content" (Preamble d), so the inserted clause uses that defined term to avoid a dangling reference.
- **Cure:** one paragraph inserted after p0049 carrying all six preferred elements (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in standard machine-readable format, certified deletion after return), with the 90-day/30-day fallback offered in the comment.
